profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Walmart Global Tech
profile.summary:
Software Engineer specializing in React.js and related frameworks, with full-stack skills and an eye for product and user experience design.

Fluent in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and React.js, and at home with many toolsets, including Node.js, Webpack, Docker, GraphQL, and SQL. Passionate about well-organized architecture that enables clean code and easy collaboration.

projects.title: Microhoods
projects.description:
Microhoods is a social map that shows you what you want to know about your city. 

This application was built using Angular, Express, Mongoose and Passport.

projects.title: QuickCall
projects.description:
QuickCall is a mobile application that lets people make Internet-based international calls. The app is one of the very first dialer apps published on Firefox OS Marketplace.

The application was built using the Angular, Ionic, Express, and Plivo API.
